Artificial intelligence is a powerful, promising, and rapidly evolving technology. I appreciate the opportunity to meet with representatives from Microsoft today to discuss strategies to enhance AI safety for our nation and the world. https://t.co/KqxwB5jO3T

Energy demand is soaring, and it’s needed 24/7. Nuclear energy provides reliable, clean electricity for homes, businesses, and a growing data and AI ecosystem. We need @NEI members now more than ever! https://t.co/Uu3R6cjSyy
This is a race right now, it is the fourth industrial revolution.

Congratulations to Laura Swett on recently being named @FERC Chairman. As former North Dakota utility regulators, @RepFedorchak and I kicked off our morning meeting with Chairman Swett. She understands the value of states’ rights and is willing to shake up norms to make sure we meet the growing electricity demand. If America is going to win the AI revolution, we need to be poised with the right policies to get electricity to data centers.

Thanks to @RepMikeCollins for meeting with me on his PERMIT Act. @EPWGOP is ready to get to work on permitting certainty to make the United States energy, mineral, and AI dominant. https://t.co/FuUtom6dDc

I commend the leadership of @POTUS and Chairman @SenCapito in reforming and modernizing the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Our historic AI-driven power demand can only be met with the dispatchable power provided by nuclear, coal, and natural gas.

If we want to meet the need for American AI and energy dominance, we need creative solutions like @armada_ai. Sat down with CEO Dan Wright to discuss applications for Armada’s technology. https://t.co/TzK0gP0Y5F

From talking about the importance of telemedicine for rural communities to how AI is reshaping care delivery, @EssentiaHealth CEO Dr. David Herman and I covered a lot of ground in our meeting. We discussed real challenges and ideas to improve the experience for patients and clinicians.

Armada is doing AI and data centers the right way: with transparency, scalability, and a clear vision for the future. Jon Runyan, co-founder and Chief Operating Officer of @armada_ai, and I talked about what’s next after the grand opening. https://t.co/BYLIEELvia

I spoke at an @ACCFmedia permitting reform event and said without it, our ability to keep pace with our adversaries on everything from AI to defense is jeopardized. Constitutionally, legally, and morally—we should do permitting reform for the sake of our country. We should not be our own stumbling block when it comes to our first Constitutional duty of the defense of the nation.
